title: Grassification Maldegem roadside site-access and field observations
description: English, row-level extract of ten site observations from Appendix 1 of Grassification deliverable D1.1.2. Records include source-reported slope, manual pin penetration, and visible-litter class. Coordinates are retained only where the source text maps them unambiguously to a sample row.
source_title: D1.1.2 Report: Testing & comparison of performance new type of mowing head against existing mowing heads
source_location: PDF p.24, Appendix 1, ten roadside inspection points
license: No explicit reuse license identified in the public deliverable. Attribution retained; confirm reuse terms before broader redistribution.
applicability: Site-specific evidence for roadside accessibility, slope, qualitative visible litter, and a simple manual ground-penetration observation. It can inform which field constraints should be represented, but is not a regional Dutch distribution or a validated machine-access equation.
conversion_and_scaling: Dutch column labels and qualitative litter classes translated into English. Numeric values and units are transcribed as reported. Coordinates for point 4 are blank because the extracted source text does not unambiguously associate coordinates with that row. No site-average or extrapolation was calculated.
uncertainty: Ten points from one roadside corridor; no uncertainty distribution or sampling design suitable for regional inference. The source reports a site-level slope range of 10–51 degrees and mean of 22 degrees elsewhere; point values are not used to recompute or replace that summary. Manual pin penetration is not a standardized soil-strength measure. Litter classes are visual categories, not mass fractions.
provenance_note: Separate table from the already staged mowing-head comparison dataset, reusing the same source ID. No feedstock, logistics, equipment, or default parameter is changed.
